description: This file defines macros for CUDA error checking, specifically for use with the PyTorch project. It includes macros for checking CUDA calls and kernel launches, with conditional compilation based on the Torch feature version.

methods.name: STD_CUDA_CHECK
methods.description: Checks the result of a CUDA runtime call. Throws a runtime_error with an appropriate message if an error is detected.

methods.name: STD_CUDA_KERNEL_LAUNCH_CHECK
methods.description: Checks for errors after launching a CUDA kernel by calling cudaGetLastError.
